Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates LLM-based coding agents on real GitHub issues by asking the model to generate a patch that makes a repository’s tests pass. The “Verified” subset contains tasks that have been manually validated as solvable with the provided repo state and instructions, emphasizing reliable end-to-end software repair.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Adaptive Error Correction (minor)
L3: Inhibitory Control (minor)

Description: SWE-bench Multilingual extends SWE-bench-style real-repository bug fixing beyond Python to multiple programming languages and ecosystems. It stresses whether an agent can generalize debugging, testing, and patching behaviors across differing toolchains, idioms, and build systems.
Cognitive Functions:

L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Semantic Understanding & Context Recognition (minor)
L3: Cognitive Flexibility, Inhibitory Control (minor)

Description: SWE-bench Pro is a larger and more challenging software engineering benchmark designed to be more industrially representative and harder to overfit, typically requiring deeper codebase understanding and longer fix trajectories. Cognitive Functions:
